name: ecommerce-outbox-connector
_notes: route.topic.replacement produces 'inventory.product.events' and 'inventory.stock.events' from aggregate_type values 'product'/'stock', matching the design doc's topic names.

aggregate_type='order' routes to 'inventory.order.events' by this same template — override with a second connector or a ScriptedRouter if 'customer.order.events' naming is required verbatim; not done here to keep one connector for the single shared outbox table.

SMT property names are for Debezium 2.7's outbox EventRouter as documented at build time — verify against the exact installed connector version before registering (POST this file to http://localhost:8083/connectors), since these have changed across Debezium major versions.

DB_USER / DB_PASSWORD are substituted from the same .env values used by mysql/services — Kafka Connect needs its own env passthrough or a configured ConfigProvider if not run via docker-compose env_file.
